charge_port.notes: Estimated: electrive 2025-09-08 / InsideEVs: Audi's EVs lack a NACS port and need an adapter; no source shows a NACS Q8 for MY2025 (ChargePapa is ambiguous on later years).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs 2025-09-08: all Audi EVs except the Q4 e-tron are compatible with Tesla Superchargers (Canada on the same date) with an adapter; the Q8 is not named, and electrive says the Audi adapter is only supplied with new 2025 Q6, A6 and GT and is not yet sold to existing owners.
